conditional_findings.classification: New conditional current source question: a specimen output cap does not bound the preceding site enumeration and candidate sorting.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: If large supported scene extents reach placement, enumeration and temporary candidates can grow with scene area before the 512 output cap is applied.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Scene extent admission, botanical site spacing and candidate-priority sampling policy.
conditional_findings.trace: placements computes floor(terrain.width/2m) and floor(terrain.depth/2m), visits every site, collects survivors, sorts the candidates, then truncates to512. Dimension-only example: a601-by-601 source grid at20m spacing passes local source dimension/spacing guards; upsampling keeps the600-cell side, giving a12,000m width. Refinement to0.5m would produce24,001 vertices per axis and3,456,000,000 indices, within the shown u32 dimension checks, and placement would visit6,000 squared, or36,000,000, sites if it reached the loop. At most512 candidates are retained afterward.
conditional_findings.safeguards: This is symbolic integer reasoning from individual guards, not a complete validated scene, supported caller, successful allocation, prepared terrain, cover mask or measured performance. Full source and grounding checks, the32MiB file-load limit, terrain/ground preparation, materialization memory and device limits may prevent reaching the loop. A much larger601-by-601 grid at2,000m spacing is rejected by the shown refined terrain dimension capacity before placement; it is not a supported witness. Understory has a separate area walk with different spacing and semantics; exact alias and shared remedy remain open.
dependencies: Trace complete accepted document and all supported producers through terrain refinement, ground mask construction, resource limits and the actual plant call.
Establish intended scene extent and deterministic population priority policy before selecting an early bound or sampling algorithm.
acceptance_requirements: Supported scenes have an explicit, deterministic and resource-bounded plant-site selection policy that preserves intended spatial distribution and seasonal/species behavior.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; source-level bound and symbolic dimension-only illustration; reachability, policy, cost and aliases open
